# A Strategic Approach to Demonstrating the Value of OSS Efforts | Fast Wonder

## A Strategic Approach to Demonstrating the Value of OSS Efforts

OSPOs and other open source teams often struggle to demonstrate the value of their work in a way that resonates with the people in leadership positions within their organization. The topic of demonstrating open source value is one that I’ve been blogging about and giving presentations about frequently over the past year, so this blog post is a way for me to collect all of that work in one place to make it easier for people to find.

In the [CHAOSS OSPO Working Group](https://github.com/chaoss/wg-ospo), which I co-chair, the topic of how to demonstrate the value of our work in open source has been a popular topic since we started the group many years ago. However, given the current financial climate and the number of OSPOs that have been the targets of cutbacks and layoffs, this feels like a particularly important topic right now.  This is why we created a CHAOSS Practitioner Guide all about [Demonstrating Organizational Value](https://chaoss.community/practitioner-guide-demonstrating-org-value/), which I [blogged about when the guide was launched](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/07/22/demonstrating-organizational-value/).  In a second blog post on the topic, [More about Demonstrating Organizational Value](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/10/07/more-about-demonstrating-organizational-value/), I talked about the [episode of CHAOSScast](https://podcast.chaoss.community/120) where [Bob Killen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mrbobbytables/) and I joined [Harmony Elendu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harmonyelendu/) to share our thoughts about how organizations can more effectively demonstrate the value of their open source efforts.

I expanded on this topic in another blog post, [OSPO Contribution Strategies to Demonstrate Value](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/02/15/ospo-contribution-strategies-to-demonstrate-value/). This post highlights how to articulate the importance of your contributions to upstream projects as part of a broader open source strategy, which often has 2 components: 1) identifying which projects are most strategic / critical for your organization and 2) creating contribution strategies for individual projects. The blog post has examples of how I did this when I worked at VMware and Pivotal.

I’ve also presented on this topic [several times recently](https://fastwonderblog.com/speaking/), but I wanted to highlight the two most recent talks, since they are the most comprehensive examples of these presentations. I [blogged about my talk for the folks from CURIOSS](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/04/07/curioss-demonstrating-open-source-value/) (Community for University and Research Institution OSPOs) where I expanded on the content in the guide to also include more about how to demonstrate value in a university context. I further expanded it beyond corporate and university contexts to include how government / public sector organizations can demonstrate the value of their work in my talk at the Open Source Summit in Minneapolis a few weeks ago. Here’s the [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uhnTkYTiv6o&list=PLbzoR-pLrL6p2URzlq8xlNtBhPspd2xpi) and [slides](https://fastwonderblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Demonstrating-Value-OSSNA-2026.pdf) for this most recent version of the talk.

If you want feedback or help with your open source strategy and how to demonstrate value for your organization, I’m available for [consulting engagements](https://fastwonder.com/).

# 展現 OSS 工作價值的策略性方法 | Fast Wonder

## 展現 OSS 工作價值的策略性方法

開源計畫辦公室（OSPO）和其他開源團隊，常常很難用能讓組織內領導階層有感的方式，展現自己工作的價值。過去一年，我經常在部落格和簡報中談到如何展現開源價值這個主題，所以這篇文章是我把這些工作整理到同一個地方，讓大家更容易找到。

在我共同主持的 [CHAOSS OSPO Working Group](https://github.com/chaoss/wg-ospo) 中，自從我們多年前成立這個小組以來，如何展現我們在開源工作上的價值，一直是很受關注的主題。不過，考量到目前的財務環境，以及許多 OSPO 成為縮編與裁員目標的情況，這個主題現在顯得特別重要。這也是為什麼我們製作了一份 CHAOSS 實務指南，專門談[展現組織價值](https://chaoss.community/practitioner-guide-demonstrating-org-value/)；我也在這份指南推出時[寫了一篇文章介紹](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/07/22/demonstrating-organizational-value/)。在第二篇相關文章 [More about Demonstrating Organizational Value](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/10/07/more-about-demonstrating-organizational-value/) 中，我談到那集 [CHAOSScast](https://podcast.chaoss.community/120)：[Bob Killen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mrbobbytables/) 和我加入 [Harmony Elendu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/harmonyelendu/)，分享我們對於組織如何更有效展現其開源投入價值的看法。

我在另一篇文章 [OSPO Contribution Strategies to Demonstrate Value](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/02/15/ospo-contribution-strategies-to-demonstrate-value/) 中進一步延伸這個主題。這篇文章強調，如何把你對上游專案的貢獻重要性，放進更大的開源策略中清楚說明；這樣的策略通常有兩個組成部分：1) 找出哪些專案對你的組織最具策略性／關鍵性，以及 2) 為個別專案制定貢獻策略。這篇文章也舉例說明我在 VMware 和 Pivotal 工作時，是如何做到這件事的。

我最近也[多次就這個主題發表演講](https://fastwonderblog.com/speaking/)，但我想特別標出最近兩場，因為它們是這些簡報中最完整的範例。我曾[寫過一篇文章，介紹我為 CURIOSS](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/04/07/curioss-demonstrating-open-source-value/)（Community for University and Research Institution OSPOs，大學與研究機構開源專案辦公室社群）成員所做的演講；在那場演講中，我延伸了指南裡的內容，也加入更多關於如何在大學脈絡下展現價值的討論。幾週前，我在明尼亞波利斯的 Open Source Summit 演講中，又進一步把內容從企業和大學脈絡擴展到政府／公部門組織，說明它們如何展現自身工作的價值。這裡是這場最新版本演講的[影片](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uhnTkYTiv6o&list=PLbzoR-pLrL6p2URzlq8xlNtBhPspd2xpi)和[投影片](https://fastwonderblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Demonstrating-Value-OSSNA-2026.pdf)。

如果你想針對開源策略，以及如何為你的組織展現價值取得回饋或協助，我也提供[顧問服務](https://fastwonder.com/)。

- [更多關於展現組織價值的討論](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/10/07/more-about-demonstrating-organizational-value/)
- [OSPO 用來展現價值的貢獻策略](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/02/15/ospo-contribution-strategies-to-demonstrate-value/)
- [CURIOSS：展現開源價值](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/04/07/curioss-demonstrating-open-source-value/)
- [運用 CHAOSS 實務指南改善你的 OSS 專案](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/05/08/using-chaoss-practitioner-guides-to-improve-your-oss-projects/)
- [從資料到行動：打造健康且可持續的開源專案](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/05/28/from-data-to-action-building-healthy-and-sustainable-open-source-projects/)
- [貢獻者永續性如何影響 OSS 專案的風險與採用](https://fastwonderblog.com/2025/06/15/contributor-sustainability-impacts-risk-and-adoption-of-oss-projects/)
- [OSPO 的策略方法](https://fastwonderblog.com/2026/01/10/a-strategic-approach-for-ospos/)
